summary: Implemented Console.out in rich/console.py (placed after print; joins str() of objects with sep, delegates once to print with emoji/markup off, no_wrap on, overflow ignore, crop off, passing style, highlight (default True), and end). Added tests in tests/test_console.py (test_out plus markup, emoji, container, no-crop, return value, style, highlight default/false/none, render hook; imported RenderHook at top). Added CHANGELOG bullet "Added Console.out" under Unreleased Added, and a "Low level output" section in docs/source/console.rst after logging. Nothing was run or committed. Unverified: test_out_empty expectation of "\n", test_out_no_crop behavior, and exact highlight bytes (tests check only presence/absence of escape sequences).
